text:
Sam Nguyen: hi all — I'm Sam, started today on infra-eng. quick access q: who owns VPN, GitHub org perms, GCP project roles, Dedicated cluster creds, and who to ping for urgent prod access? trying to map who-to-ask for day 0.
Ava Patel: welcome Sam! 👋 short map: Eng Infra -> GitHub org perms & CI; Eng Platform -> Dedicated pools & GCP infra; SRE -> prod oncall & emergency access; People Ops -> badge/VPN; Security -> IAM approvals.
Len Cho: tl;dr list: 
• GitHub org → @ava + #eng-infra
• GCP projects → #eng-platform-iam (cc @eng-platform)
• VPN / badge → people-ops forms (handbook link)
• Dedicated cluster → eng-platform
• Emergency prod access / breakglass → page #eng-oncall and DM eng-oncall rotation
Sam Nguyen: sweet, thanks. is there a single doc or form I should open for the requests? handbook is a bit scattered.
Ava Patel: yeah, start with the access request form (see Devex Bot reminder), and attach which repos/projects you need. docs: /handbook/access/technical-access.md and /handbook/oncall/rotations.md. For Dedicated prod creds you'll need 2 approvals (security + platform).
Devex Bot: Reminder — New hire checklist: submit access request: https://intranet.redwood/internal/access-request (this auto-posts to #eng-infra).
Sam Nguyen: great. last one — repo write perms for `redwood-serving` specifically — who approves that?
Mira Fernandez: I can approve for core-serving repos. tag me with a short justification and I'll review.
Len Cho: for speed, include exact GitHub org path and whether you need write vs triage. add @ava + @Mira in the request.
Sam Nguyen: perfect, DMing @Ava and @Mira now. thanks everyone :rocket:
